notes.title: HOTFIX UPDATE: Critical Issues Fixed + Performance Improvements!
notes.notes:
[h1]HOTFIX UPDATE: CRITICAL ISSUES FIXED![/h1][p]

[/p][h2]FIXES INCLUDED[/h2][p]
• Fixed soldier gun shot and some audios not playing properly
• Resolved boss characters accumulating on ground
• Fixed save file directory issues for new players
• Improved exit game stability
• Updated flamethrower soldier sound
• Balanced audio volume levels
• Tutorial boost step now auto-triggers enemy waves
• Video player system stabilization
• Updated Unity editor version
• Disabled ALT toggle info by default (press ALT to re-enable building level indicator visuals and zombie health bars)
• General performance optimizations


[/p][h2]CONTINUED SUPPORT[/h2][p]
We're constantly monitoring community feedback and working to improve the game experience. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please let us know through our community channels.

[b]Your feedback drives our improvements![/b]

[/p][h2]WHAT'S NEXT[/h2][p]
This hotfix addresses immediate concerns, but we're not stopping here. Our roadmap continues with Part 2 coming October 11, bringing even more improvements and new features to City Defense Z.

[b]Stay tuned for more updates and keep the feedback coming![/b]

[/p][h1]SPECIAL PATCH: HAND-DRAWN NPCS + FPS IMPROVEMENTS[/h1][p]
[/p][h2]WE HEARD YOUR FEEDBACK[/h2][p]
You told us you didn't like the AI-generated NPC art. We listened. We worked day and night to replace every single AI-generated portrait with hand-drawn artwork.

[/p][h2]WHAT'S CHANGED[/h2][p]
[b]Hand-Drawn NPC Characters[/b]
• All AI-generated NPC portraits replaced with hand-drawn art
• Created by our team, no more AI Art content

[b]FPS Improvements[/b]

notes.title: Patch Rollback Due to Steam Cloud Save Issues
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799285/cbea22f381dac2826f17c15f728660ebd52156f7.png"][/img]

[h1][b]Patch Rollback Due to Steam Cloud Save Issues[/b][/h1][p]
Hey everyone,[/p][p]Earlier today, we released a patch as part of [b]Developer Challenge Day 4[/b]. Unfortunately, we encountered unexpected issues with the [b]Steam Cloud Save[/b] system that did not appear during our local testing.[/p][p]To avoid further disruption, we've rolled back to the [b]previous stable version[/b] of the game. This should restore normal functionality for all players.[/p][p]We’re actively working on a fix and plan to [b]release the corrected patch tomorrow[/b] during early working hours.[/p][p]We're sorry for the inconvenience and really appreciate your patience and support.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: DAY 4/10: Hotfix Update - Enhanced Gameplay & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[h1]DAY 4/10: HOTFIX UPDATE - ENHANCED GAMEPLAY & BUG FIXES[/h1][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799285/70a37470bd514d4a00e66d8a8445a2ad23f2abca.png"][/img][/p][h2]DAY 4: HOTFIX UPDATE[/h2][p]Today, we're releasing a comprehensive hotfix that addresses critical gameplay issues and enhances the overall player experience. These improvements ensure that when you launch into survival, everything works exactly as intended.  [b][i]Polish, performance, and player experience improvements.[/i][/b]


[b]Every detail matters when survival is on the line[/b]

Today's update focuses on the small details that make a big difference. From visual polish to critical bug fixes, we've addressed the issues that matter most to players. When you're fighting for survival, you need every advantage - and every system working perfectly.

[/p][h2]CRITICAL FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS[/h2][p]

[b]Enhanced gameplay experience with polished mechanics[/b]

[/p][h3]Map Progression & UI Enhancements[/h3][p][b]Improved navigation and user interface[/b]

[b]Map Transition Confirmation:[/b]
• Added "Do you want to exit?" confirmation panel when reaching Day 30 on the first map
• Prevents accidental progression and gives players control over their timing
• Seamless transition between maps with clear player choice

[b]Enhanced Resource Management:[/b]
• [b]NEW:[/b] Basic Soldier count now displayed in the TOP UI resource bar
• Real-time visibility of your military strength at a glance
• Better strategic planning with immediate troop information

[b]Improved Combat Visualization:[/b]
• [b]NEW:[/b] Radial white sprite indicators showing soldier attack ranges
 • Clear tactical information for optimal unit placement
 • Enhanced strategic depth with visible combat zones  [/p][h3]Combat & Visual Improvements[/h3][p][b]Polished combat mechanics and visual effects[/b]

[b]Stonefist Stone Enhancements:[/b]
• [b]FIXED:[/b] Random appearance issues on map locations
• [b]NEW:[/b] Added explosion effects to Stonefist stones
• More satisfying and impactful combat interactions
• Consistent visual behavior across all map areas

[b]Soldier Visibility Fixes:[/b]
• [b]FIXED:[/b] Soldier shadow rendering issues
• Improved visual clarity and depth perception
• Better integration with environmental lighting
• Enhanced overall visual polish

[b]Combat System Improvements:[/b]
• [b]FIXED:[/b] Random bullet visual artifacts in air
• Cleaner, more consistent projectile rendering
• [b]NEW:[/b] Population requirement notifications for Machine Gun units
• Clear feedback when resources are insufficient for unit deployment

[/p][h3]Gameplay Mechanics & Stability[/h3][p][b]Enhanced reliability and user experience[/b]

[b]Daytime duration has increased from 120 seconds to 240 seconds.[/b]

[b]Card System Improvements:[/b]
• [b]FIXED:[/b] Aircraft card spawning issues
• More consistent and reliable card distribution
• Better balance in unit availability

[b]Reroll System Fixes:[/b]
• [b]FIXED:[/b] Reroll button activation inconsistencies
• Reliable access to card refresh functionality
• Improved strategic flexibility

[b]Steam Cloud Save Synchronization:[/b]
• [b]CRITICAL FIX:[/b] Enhanced Steam Cloud save functionality
• [b]IMPORTANT:[/b] For proper synchronization, load your save on the original device first, then access on new devices
• Reliable cross-device progress preservation
• Seamless gaming experience across multiple platforms

[/p][h2]VISUAL POLISH & USER EXPERIENCE[/h2][p]
[b]Every detail refined for maximum immersion[/b]

[b]UI Enhancements:[/b]
• Cleaner resource bar with soldier count integration
• More intuitive combat range indicators
• Improved visual feedback for all interactions

[b]Combat Clarity:[/b]
• Fixed shadow rendering for better depth perception
• Eliminated visual artifacts that could distract from gameplay
• Enhanced explosion effects for more satisfying combat

[b]Strategic Information:[/b]
• Real-time soldier count visibility
• Clear combat range indicators for tactical planning
• Improved notification system for resource requirements

[/p][h2]PERFORMANCE & STABILITY[/h2][p]
[b]Optimized for smooth survival gameplay[/b]

[b]Technical Improvements:[/b]
• Enhanced Steam Cloud save reliability
• Fixed visual rendering issues
• Improved UI responsiveness
• Better resource management system

[b]Cross-Platform Compatibility:[/b]
• Reliable save synchronization across devices
• Consistent performance across different hardware
• Optimized for various screen resolutions



[i][b]Stay connected, Survivors...[/b][/i]

notes.title: City Defense Z – Release Announcement
notes.notes: [h3]Hey Survivors,[/h3][p][/p][p]You’ve been waiting a long time. You played our three different demos, tested the shifting world of the game, and gave us feedback that helped take City Defense Z beyond what we ever imagined. Now this city has been rebuilt from that very first demo, keeping the core gameplay you loved but transforming it into a brand new game with a completely different challenge.[/p][p][/p][p]Behind the scenes, we worked through dozens of files named “FINAL,” “FINAL2,” and “ReallyFinal.” And now, we’re ready to show you what’s next.[/p][p][/p][p]City Defense Z launches in full on August 26th. The zombies are at the gates, and the city is counting on your command.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799285/15764b315d1d979597f689be5ef8a65230f16ff4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]In the new rogue-lite structure of City Defense Z, every game promises a completely different journey. [/p][/*][*][p] Cards will determine your military strength, discoveries, and decisions—shaping your survival. [/p][/*][*][p]Turn your city from an ordinary defense base into a living, growing world that reacts to your choices. [/p][/*][*][p]Manage your citizens, soldiers, and resources to maintain that delicate balance between survival and expansion. [/p][/*][*][p]Command your forces with new tools: merge soldiers to create stronger units, deploy advanced classes, and push back the ever-growing zombie threat. [/p][/*][*][p]Stay up to date with breaking news. New opportunities, unexpected threats, and special situations await you in the “Breaking News” feed—the early bird wins! [/p][/*][*][p] Grow stronger after every attempt with permanent upgrades. With multiple save slots and different maps, plan your long-term strategy and turn your city into a legend. [/p][/*][*][p]It’s no longer just about defense—produce the food to keep your army alive, gather resources directly from your buildings, and sustain your war effort. [/p][/*][*][p]Face unpredictable challenges, from unique zombie types to massive boss encounters, and strengthen your defenses with walls. [/p][/*][*][p]Meet unique NPCs, each with their own stories, personalities, and benefits. Send them on expeditions into the unknown to find rare materials and powerful rewards. [/p][/*][*][p]Command your forces with new tools: merge soldiers to create stronger units, deploy advanced classes, and push back the ever-growing zombie threat.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="N3BJ_6YAGH4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The countdown begins… Soon, we’ll all be counting down from 10 together. With each step, you’ll discover new content, uncover surprises, and meet a new character. Stay tuned, and don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist![/p][p][/p][p]You can learn more about City Defense Z by visiting our official website or joining our Discord community![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://citydefensez.com" style="button"]Official Website[/url][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/6r2GU68cDA" style="button"]Official Discord[/url][/p][p][url="https://city-defense-z.fandom.com/wiki/City_Defense_Z_Wiki" style="button"]City Defense Z Wiki[/url][/p]

notes.title: Major Content Update Incoming!
notes.notes:
[p][b]City Defense Z is about to transform into an entirely new experience with its most ambitious content update yet. You may not see it in the game just yet, but a major change has begun in the city.[/b][/p][p]This update isn't just about adding new content, it breathes fresh life into the very soul of the game. Your city is no longer just a collection of blocks on a map. It’s becoming a living, breathing world that talks, gives quests, grows, and evolves alongside you.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799285/e0d7db1cff44a3b202a5ee7fa575e7927e98d604.png"][/img][/p][p]In addition, we now have a rogue-lite structure. Every playthrough will be a different journey, and your cards, discoveries, military power and decisions will shape that journey.[/p][p]Meet NPCs and send them on expeditions. Merge your soldiers to make them stronger. Use the new card system to build your defenses wisely, seize trade opportunities and follow what is happening on the map dynamically. Because now in City Defense Z, every day, every decision and every detail matters even more. The zombies may still be coming, but you are no longer just defending.[/p][p][i]This time there is a bit of conversation, a bit of tactics, and yes, plenty of fun.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]NPC and
